title: SEC. 37.3. RENT LIMITATIONS.
evidence_excerpt: (1) Annual Rent Increase On March 1 of each year the Board shall publish the increase in the CPI for the preceding 12 months as made available by US Dept Labor. A landlord who has reported required information shall have license to impose annually rent increase which does not exceed base rent by more than 60% of said published increase. In no event however shall allowable annual increase be greater than 7%. A landlord who refrains from imposing increase may accumulate said increase and subject to Section 37.15 impose that amount on subsequent anniversary dates.
supports: Official text 60% CPI capped at 7% banking license requirement
